name: hud_ui_load_game_primary_action_button_on_activate
description: HudUiLoadGamePrimaryActionButton::OnActivate dispatches the owning load-game dialog primary action when an owner is present, then runs the base ZRD widget activation.
known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_button_on_activate_cluster passes for 0x435200 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x435200 validates loading owner from HudUiZrdWidget offset 0xc8, skipping a null owner, calling HudUiLoadGameDialog::OnPrimaryAction for a non-null owner, and always calling HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
The native smoke covers the non-null-owner dispatch through an empty load-game dialog, validates the resulting QueueExitCurrentState(0), then covers the null-owner path without queuing an exit.
